item.coloph: ces pa sgya 'phrul gsang ba gtso mchog thugs kyi sgrub pa 'di ni/ mdo smad 'dra gnas g.yung drung rin chen 'bar ba nas zab gter rin po che spyan drangs shing / phyis su bka' rgya grol ba'i dus babs khro spral g.yung drung mthong grol khro dbon yid bzhin dbang rgyal grogs dbang gi sgron ma mchog spral g.yung drung sogs kyi zab gter phab dgos kyi dgongs bzhed dang / khyad par rang slob g.yung drung rgyal mtshan gyis lha steg rin chen 'khor lo bris shog sogs kyi brdas mtshon nas nam mkha' ye shes g.yung dpal sogs kyis bskul ngor/ mkha' 'gro'i brda yig bod yig tu gsang sngags gling pas dag par phab pas g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig/
